faces.name: Dominion Infiltration
faces.oracleText: Choose X target creatures your opponents control. For each of them, create a token that's a copy of that creature, except it has changeling. Those tokens gain haste. Exile those tokens at the beginning of the next end step. (They're every creature type.)

faces.name: Dominion Saboteur
faces.oracleText: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any artifact or creature on the battlefield, except it isn't legendary. If you do, it enters with additional counters on it equal to the same number and kinds of counters the copied permanent has on it.

faces.name: Dominion Supervisor
faces.oracleText:
When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
Creatures you control with counters on them have trample.

faces.name: Dominus of Fealty
faces.oracleText:
Flying
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may gain control of target permanent until end of turn. If you do, untap it and it gains haste until end of turn.
